summary: The article accurately describes SEBI's expanded regulatory framework for vault managers, extending it to cover gold and silver ETFs and other bullion-related instruments, and highlights the benefits for investor protection and transparency.

claims.claim: SEBI has introduced a comprehensive framework for vault managers storing physical gold and silver bullion underlying ETFs.
claims.note: SEBI expanded its regulatory framework for vault managers to cover bullion underlying gold and silver ETFs and bullion derivatives.

claims.claim: These new rules mandate stricter standards for storage, security, segregation, and reconciliation of precious metals.
claims.note: The amended framework strengthens requirements around storage, safekeeping, segregation, reconciliation, insurance, security, and governance.

claims.claim: Under the new framework, entities acting as vault managers for precious metals underlying Gold and Silver ETFs must now register with SEBI.
claims.note: The SEBI (Vault Managers) Regulations, 2021, which were amended, cover registration and eligibility of vault managers.

claims.claim: The regulations mandate a common set of operating procedures for all vault managers. This includes stringent security measures for the vaults, such as robust physical security, surveillance systems, and access controls.
claims.note: Vault managers will have to strengthen their security policies to address risks including theft, burglary, fire, fraud, terrorism and cyberattacks.

claims.claim: The minimum net-worth requirement for vault managers will be increased to Rs 75 crore from Rs 50 crore.
claims.note: The net worth requirement for vault managers will be increased to Rs 75 crore from Rs 50 crore.

article_title: SEBI's New Vault Rules: Enhanced Security for Gold & Silver ETFs
